postings.title: Software Engineer Intern, Summer 2027
postings.text:
About Acme
Acme builds payment tools for thousands of merchants. Our platform runs on Kubernetes and handles millions of requests.

What you'll do
Build backend services in Java and Spring Boot.
Ship features end to end with a small team.

Requirements
Currently enrolled in a BS or MS program in Computer Science.
Experience with Java and SQL.
Graduating in 2028 or 2029.

Nice to have
Familiarity with Docker.
Exposure to AWS.

Benefits
Competitive pay. Hybrid schedule.

postings.title: Frontend Engineering Intern
postings.text:
Help us build the product UI.
Requirements:
Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript
Experience with React
Comfort with HTML and CSS
Preferred qualifications:
Experience with Node.js
Open to rising juniors and seniors. Must be authorized to work in the US; we cannot offer visa sponsorship.
postings.workAuthorization: Must be authorized to work in the US; we cannot offer visa sponsorship.

postings.title: Platform Intern (Go)
postings.text:
Join the platform team. Go to our careers page to learn more about the team.
You will write services in Go and deploy them with Docker.
Qualifications
Programming experience in Go, Python or Rust.
Knowledge of Linux.
We value R&D and curiosity. Go-to-market experience is not required.

postings.title: Data Science Intern
postings.text:
Data Science Intern - Summer 2026
Our R&D group analyses clinical trial data.
Qualifications
Skills in R, Python and SQL.
Coursework in statistics or machine learning.
Bonus
Experience with Kubernetes is a plus.

postings.title: Embedded Software Intern
postings.text:
You will write firmware in C and C++ for our devices.
Requirements
Strong C programming skills.
Familiarity with C++ is a plus.
Security clearance is not required but US citizenship is preferred for some projects.
Expected graduation date 2027.
postings.workAuthorization: Security clearance is not required but US citizenship is preferred for some projects.

postings.title: Software Engineer Intern - .NET
postings.text:
We build line-of-business software with C# and .NET on Azure.
Minimum qualifications
Experience with C# or Java.
Knowledge of SQL Server.
Preferred
Experience with ASP.NET MVC, Docker.
Must be eligible to work in the United States.
postings.workAuthorization: Must be eligible to work in the United States.

postings.title: Machine Learning Research Intern, Fall 2027
postings.text:
Work with our research team on large-scale ML systems.
What we're looking for:
Pursuing a PhD or MS. Strong Python.
Experience with machine learning frameworks.
Publications are a plus.
Class of 2028 or 2029.

postings.title: iOS Engineering Intern
postings.text:
Build our iOS app in Swift.
Requirements
Experience with Swift or Kotlin
You can move quickly and ship.
We are an equal opportunity employer. Swift-moving teams only.

postings.title: Security Engineering Intern
postings.text:
Help secure our products.
Responsibilities
Review code in Python and Go for vulnerabilities.
Qualifications
Interest in application security.
Basic knowledge of networking.
Nice to have
Experience with Rust.
Candidates must be US citizens or permanent residents.
postings.workAuthorization: Candidates must be US citizens or permanent residents.

postings.title: Backend Intern
postings.text:
We need a backend intern who knows Java, Spring and PostgreSQL. You will pair with senior engineers on APIs.
Bring Docker experience if you have it. Summer 2027 start, 12 weeks.

postings.title: Intern
postings.text:
Let's go! We offer a go-getter culture, a great place to go for growth, and lunch.
Requirements
Ability to work in a team.

postings.title: Product Operations Intern
postings.text:
Work directly with our C-level team and the R&D leads. Plan A or plan B, you decide.
Requirements
Excellent communication.
Spreadsheet skills.

postings.title: Full Stack Intern
postings.text:
Stack: nodejs, reactjs, k8s, TS.
Requirements
Experience with JS and Node.
Preferred
Golang or cpp a plus.

postings.title: Software Intern
postings.text:
Open to students graduating in December 2027 or later. Internship runs Winter 2027.
No visa sponsorship available.
Requirements
Python.

postings.title: Systems Intern
postings.text:
Requirements
Languages: C, C++, C#, Go, R
Tools: Docker/Kubernetes
Prior internships in finance a plus.

postings.title: Marketing Intern
postings.text: Help with campaigns. No technical skills needed.
